deposits.definition: Sum of branch-office deposits (DEPSUMBR, reported in $ thousands, converted to millions) for Bank of America, N.A. (FDIC cert 3510) and Bank of America California, N.A. footprint.notes: State rows come from two sources, so a state can appear twice with different metric keys: (1) FDIC Summary of Deposits, June 30, 2026 survey (the newest release), aggregated server-side by the FDIC BankFind API by branch state for both Bank of America insured charters (cert 3510 and cert 25178, the single-office Bank of America California, N.A.); 'count' is office records and 'sum_DEPSUMBR' is deposits in $ thousands, stored in millions with a bracketed conversion. FDIC national totals for the query: 3,599 offices and $1,995,790,194 thousand (2024 survey: 3,744 offices). BofA has SOD offices in 38 states plus DC, the same set as in 2024; states absent from the FDIC response have no BofA branch. (2) Bank of America 'Local Impact Fact Sheet' pages (resources.bankofamerica.com/local-market/fact-sheet/<market>) give 'Local employees'; only the 11 markets named for a state (AR, CO, DE, IA, KY, ME, NH, NJ, RI, UT, WI) are used; the fact sheets do not define market boundaries, and the other ~80 are metro markets. These pages are undated; re-checked Nov 24, 2026, no newer edition found (figures unchanged). Wisconsin shows local employees but no FDIC branch offices. Not used: the 2025 10-K states 77% of ~213,000 employees were in the U.S. at Dec 31, 2025 (no country breakdown, so no countries rows; the non-U.S. remainder would be a derivation). Sites are the four principal properties in the 2025 10-K Item 2.
